notes.title: Version 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
Redesigned Settings panel with 4x more options and control!
+More control over the Sandbox tools
+Choose the defaults for the piano and "Austin" mode for wide device
+Adjust volume for Voice, SFX and Piano
+Ability to disable safety prompts
+More accessibility options for parents
+Reset button
-Reorganized home screen
